name: argus
description: Dashboard for managing multiple Claude Code CLI sessions
author: Antonio Romano <antonio@rebrandly.com>

scripts.test: npm test -w server && npm test -w client
scripts.dev:web: PORT=5401 DATA_DIR=data-dev ARGUS_TMUX_SOCKET=argus-dev concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.build:all: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client && npm run build:electron
scripts.electron:dev: npm run build:all && make -C daemon build && ARGUS_PORT=5403 electron .
scripts.package:mac: npm run check:deps && npm run build:all && make -C daemon build && npx electron-builder install-app-deps && electron-builder --mac -p never --config electron-builder.config.cjs
